formulas.aggregate_base_gradient: grad of the train-image mean L_base w.r.t. concat(Wt, Wv)
formulas.aggregate_pair_gradient: grad of the train-image mean L_pair w.r.t. concat(Wt, Wv)
formulas.effective_sample_size: 1 / sum_i p_i^2 with p_i = v_i / sum_j v_j over positive v
formulas.gini: Gini coefficient computed on the positive values only
formulas.lambda_scaling: lambda_0p25_scaled_pair_norm = lambda * pair_grad_norm; scaled ratio = lambda * pair/base
formulas.pair_norm_concentration: top-share / ESS / Gini of the positive per-image pair gradient norms
formulas.signed_contribution_concentration: top-share / ESS / Gini of the positive signed contributions
formulas.signed_projection_contribution: dot(g_i, sum_j g_j) / ||sum_j g_j||^2, computed from the mean gradient as dot(g_i, mean) / (N * ||mean||^2); sums to 1 in exact arithmetic

limitations: 梯度范数之和不是 aggregate 梯度：top-k norm share 只是模长分布，不能当作向量贡献来读；只有 signed projection contribution 才满足和约为 1。
signed projection contribution 可为负，负贡献已被单独报告；正贡献的 share/ESS/Gini 只在 positive 子集上定义，不能掩盖负质量。
lambda 为正时只改变 pair 与 base 的相对尺度，不改变 pair-only 的集中度、rank 或 cosine；本审计不据此宣布任何 lambda 为 winner。
不设通过/失败阈值，不宣布 promotion/no-promotion，不修改 DRAFT，也不授权重训。
所有数值都是 internal train-only 初始梯度诊断，不是 CV-Bench 任务精度，不能从初始梯度推断收敛、验证集改进或任务精度。

notes.descriptive_only: no pass/fail threshold is set, no winner or promotion verdict is given, and the DRAFT is not modified
notes.lambda_positive_scaling: a positive lambda only rescales pair vs base; pair-only concentration, ranks and cosines are invariant
notes.norm_sum_is_not_aggregate: summing per-image gradient norms is NOT the aggregate gradient; norm shares characterise spread of magnitude only
notes.not_task_accuracy: all numbers are internal train-only initial-gradient diagnostics, never CV-Bench task accuracy
notes.signed_contribution: dot(g_i, sum_j g_j) / ||sum_j g_j||^2 sums to 1 per seed in exact arithmetic and may be negative; the mean-gradient form dot(g_i, mean) / (N * ||mean||^2) is used to avoid materialising the full 159 x 458752 gradient set. The pooled block spans all seeds, so its expected sum is the seed count, not 1.
notes.top_share_convention: top-k% share uses k = max(1, ceil(fraction * n)) over the positive values renormalised to sum to 1
notes.zero_update: only forward and autograd.grad are used; no update rule is constructed, no parameter is written, no epoch is run

provenance.input_npz_scope: train split only; aggregate over sorted (sample_id, file sha256)

scope: train-only, CPU-only, zero-update concentration audit of the DRAFT pair loss at the frozen lambda_target_0p25 = 0.25 / r_med; per-image-pair L_base / L_pair gradients are reduced to scalars, the signed projection contribution is constructed to sum to 1 per seed, and no training, no tuning, no parameter save, no val/test feature cache read, no model load, no GPU, no network, no promotion decision and no accuracy claim is made
